notProved: No production traffic, no production data volume and no production hardware. The salon is a probe mirroring what B-CAT-06 seeds — five rooms and eight therapists — not the live one.

The latency figures are a measurement of THIS machine. availability-perf.itest.ts measured the same container six times: 192-231 ms alone and 315-417 ms inside a full run, against a 300 ms budget committed for the CI Postgres. A p95 from here separates the container’s mood and not two versions of the query (brief rule 23).
No peak has been observed, so the declared concurrency is a load somebody chose and not a forecast. There is no committed figure at any concurrency but 50 (Y13-perf-budget).

Nothing here exercises the HTTP layer, the browser or the worker process. The contention is measured at the service boundary, so "zero unhandled constraint-violation 5xx" is proved as "every rejection carried a refusal name and no raw SQLSTATE reached a caller".
The backlog is drained by several drainOutbox calls in ONE process, which exercises `for update skip locked` and does not exercise two deployed workers on two hosts.
